svg.aria-label: jest tests pass with no live Redis: retryable failure, exponential backoff, priority routing and graceful shutdown

g.text: PASS email processor returns success when the RNG is above the failure threshold
PASS email processor throws a retryable error when the RNG lands in the failure band
PASS email processor waits on the injected sleep for the configured delay
PASS email producer adds a send-notification job carrying the user payload
PASS email producer configures 3 attempts with 5s exponential backoff and removeOnComplete
PASS email producer routes password_reset at high priority (1) and other mail at low priority (10)
PASS graceful shutdown closes the worker then exits with code 0
PASS graceful shutdown exits non-zero when close never settles, rather than hanging until SIGKILL
PASS graceful shutdown exits non-zero when close rejects instead of leaving the promise unhandled
PASS graceful shutdown registers both SIGINT and SIGTERM by default
